hints.title: Compare prefixes
hints.body: Define the answer for prefixes of the two strings. The last characters decide how the prefixes can be shortened.

hints.title: Two-dimensional state
hints.body: Let `common[i][j]` be the length of the longest shared thread between the first `i` characters of `first` and the first `j` characters of `second`.

hints.title: Match or skip
hints.body: If the current last characters match, extend the answer for both shorter prefixes by one. Otherwise discard the last character of one prefix and take the better of the two possibilities.
